name: The Gentlemen
description: The Gentlemen is a ransomware-as-a-service cybercriminal group that emerged in mid-2025 and rapidly became the second most active ransomware gang by victim count, claiming over 332 published victims through 2026. The group differentiates itself by offering affiliates a 90/10 revenue split — compared to the industry standard 80/20 — accelerating growth by attracting experienced operators from competing programs. Tracked by Check Point Software.

sources.title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group 'The Gentlemen?' — Krebs on Security
